# FLOID

> Free product development scheduling software — a visual timeline builder for product teams and anyone who needs to build a project schedule.

FLOID is a browser-based scheduling tool built for product development. It helps teams plan and visualize product development timelines, launch plans, and multi-team project schedules using drag-and-drop phases, tasks, and milestones.

## Key Details

- Website: https://floid.design/
- Pricing: Free
- Platform: Web browser (no install required)
- Category: Product development scheduling, project timelines, timeline builder, milestone tracking

## What FLOID Does

FLOID lets you create project timelines with multiple schedule tracks — one per team or workstream, such as engineering, design, tooling, and marketing. Each schedule contains phases, tasks, and milestones arranged on a visual timeline. You can pin one schedule as the project reference: it renders on top and its milestone lines extend through every schedule, keeping key dates visible across the whole project.

## Core Features

- Drag-and-drop timeline scheduling
- Multiple parallel schedules per project
- Pinned reference schedule with full-height milestone lines
- Phases, tasks, and milestone tracking
- Ready-made templates: complete product development, engineering, industrial design, software, and marketing
- Color-coded schedules with a multicolor phase option
- Export as .floid file, full project backup, or timeline image
- Dark mode
- Keyboard shortcuts
- No account required

## Who It's For

- Product managers and program managers planning new product development (NPD) schedules
- Engineering and hardware teams coordinating build stages like EVT, DVT, and PVT
- Industrial designers and design managers planning design process timelines
- Marketing teams building launch timelines
- Anyone who needs a free, visual timeline builder for any kind of project schedule
